name: Python
sdg_rationale: Programming builds employable technical skills and supports digital innovation.
description: Write and understand Python programs to process information, automate tasks, and develop software.
practical_example: Use Python to clean a CSV file, check values, and produce a simple report.

name: SQL
sdg_rationale: Database querying supports technical skills and data-driven digital systems.
description: Use Structured Query Language (SQL) to retrieve, combine, filter, and update data in relational databases.
practical_example: Write a query joining two tables to answer a business question.

name: Power BI
sdg_rationale: Data analytics skills support lifelong learning and evidence-informed productivity.
description: Build interactive reports and visual dashboards using Microsoft Power BI and structured data.
practical_example: Create a dashboard with filters to compare monthly performance.

name: Data Visualization
sdg_rationale: Communicating data clearly supports workforce skills and informed organisational decisions.
description: Present data clearly using appropriate charts, tables, and visual explanations.
practical_example: Choose and label a chart that accurately communicates a trend.

name: Cloud Fundamentals
sdg_rationale: Cloud knowledge develops technical skills for modern digital infrastructure.
description: Understand fundamental cloud concepts such as hosted computing, storage, access control, and deployment.
practical_example: Compare a locally hosted application with a basic cloud-hosted deployment.

name: Networking
sdg_rationale: Networking knowledge builds technical skills needed for reliable digital infrastructure.
description: Understand how devices communicate over networks, including addressing, protocols, and connectivity.
practical_example: Investigate why a device cannot reach a network service.

name: Security Fundamentals
sdg_rationale: Security skills support resilient digital systems and protection of organisational information.
description: Recognise common digital security risks and apply basic safeguards to systems and information.
practical_example: Identify a weak access-control practice and propose a safer alternative.

name: Automation
sdg_rationale: Workflow automation can improve productivity and support technological innovation.
description: Use software tools or scripts to carry out repeatable steps with less manual effort while checking results.
practical_example: Automate a recurring data-formatting task and verify its output.

name: Software Configuration
sdg_rationale: Configuration management helps maintain reliable software and productive development workflows.
description: Set up and manage software settings, dependencies, and environments so applications run as intended.
practical_example: Configure an application environment and document the required settings.

name: Software Design
sdg_rationale: Software design develops technical capabilities used to build innovative digital solutions.
description: Plan software structure, components, interfaces, and behaviour to meet user and system requirements.
practical_example: Sketch the modules and data flow for a small application.

name: Software Testing
sdg_rationale: Software testing improves the reliability of digital products and development processes.
description: Check whether software works as intended and identify defects using planned tests and observed results.
practical_example: Write test cases for a feature and record unexpected behaviour.

name: Digital and AI Fluency
sdg_rationale: AI literacy develops relevant workforce skills for responsible adaptation to new tools.
description: Understand what digital and AI tools can do, their limitations, and how to use their outputs responsibly.
practical_example: Evaluate an AI-generated suggestion against trusted information before using it.

name: Critical Thinking
sdg_rationale: Critical thinking supports lifelong learning and informed work decisions.
description: Evaluate information, assumptions, and alternatives before forming a reasoned judgement.
practical_example: Compare two possible solutions and explain the evidence behind a decision.

name: Innovative Thinking
sdg_rationale: Innovative thinking supports more productive work and new solutions across industries.
description: Generate and evaluate useful new ideas or improvements to existing ways of working.
practical_example: Propose a practical improvement to a repetitive workflow and test the idea.

name: Financial Analysis and Reporting
sdg_rationale: Financial analysis supports sound economic decisions and more accountable reporting.
description: Interpret financial information and present meaningful summaries that support decisions.
practical_example: Compare financial results against a budget and explain significant differences.

name: Accounting Principles
sdg_rationale: Accounting knowledge supports reliable economic activity and transparent records.
description: Apply established accounting concepts to record, classify, and report financial transactions accurately.
practical_example: Classify example transactions and explain their financial-statement treatment.

name: Attention to Detail
sdg_rationale: Accuracy in financial work reduces reporting errors and improves accountability.
description: Check information and work products carefully for errors, omissions, and inconsistencies.
practical_example: Reconcile two records and investigate amounts that do not match.

name: Ethical Judgement
sdg_rationale: Ethical financial decisions support responsible work and institutional integrity.
description: Make decisions that consider honesty, confidentiality, professional responsibilities, and potential harm.
practical_example: Identify a conflict of interest and explain an appropriate response.

name: Cost-Benefit Analysis
sdg_rationale: Evaluating costs and benefits supports efficient investment and responsible resource choices.
description: Compare expected costs, benefits, and trade-offs when evaluating a proposed action.
practical_example: List the costs and benefits of two options and justify a recommendation.

name: Data Analysis
sdg_rationale: Learning to analyse information supports employable skills and better workplace decisions.
description: Examine datasets to identify patterns, answer questions, and explain findings with appropriate caution.
practical_example: Analyse a dataset to compare groups and summarise the differences.

name: Data Cleaning and Quality Checking
sdg_rationale: Preparing accurate datasets builds technical skills and supports reliable digital systems.
description: Inspect and improve dataset quality by handling missing, duplicate, inconsistent, or invalid records.
practical_example: Detect duplicate entries and document how they were handled.

name: Marketing Strategy and Campaign Planning
sdg_rationale: Planning marketing campaigns supports relevant vocational learning and productive business activity.
description: Set marketing objectives, choose audiences, and plan activities that support business goals.
practical_example: Outline a campaign objective, target segment, channel, and measurement plan.

name: Digital and Social Media Marketing
sdg_rationale: Digital marketing builds practical career skills and supports digital business activity.
description: Plan and manage marketing activity through digital channels such as search, websites, email, and social media.
practical_example: Draft a social-media campaign schedule for a defined audience.

name: Market Research and Consumer Insights
sdg_rationale: Market research skills help people analyse customer needs and make informed business decisions.
description: Gather and interpret information about customers, competitors, and market needs to inform decisions.
practical_example: Design a short customer survey and summarise the main findings.

name: Campaign Performance Analysis
sdg_rationale: Evaluating campaigns supports evidence-based learning and effective business decisions.
description: Measure campaign outcomes using suitable metrics and use results to improve marketing decisions.
practical_example: Compare campaign results against targets and recommend one adjustment.

name: Marketing Communication
sdg_rationale: Clear marketing communication supports employable professional skills and collaboration.
description: Communicate a clear, accurate marketing message suited to an audience and channel.
practical_example: Rewrite a product message for two different customer audiences.

name: Electrical System Design
sdg_rationale: Designing reliable electrical systems builds engineering skills and supports infrastructure.
description: Plan electrical systems and select suitable components while considering performance and design constraints.
practical_example: Draw a basic electrical system layout and explain component choices.

name: Electrical Circuits and Equipment
sdg_rationale: Electrical circuit knowledge supports technical learning and reliable engineering infrastructure.
description: Understand circuit behaviour and the function and characteristics of electrical components and equipment.
practical_example: Interpret a circuit diagram and explain expected component behaviour.

name: Electrical Circuit Simulation
sdg_rationale: Simulation enables testing of electrical circuit concepts before practical implementation.
description: Use simulation tools to explore how an electrical circuit may behave under specified conditions.
practical_example: Simulate a simple circuit and compare calculated and simulated results.

name: Electrical Engineering Safety and Risk
sdg_rationale: Safe electrical work and risk identification support workplace safety and resilient infrastructure.
description: Recognise electrical hazards and apply safety principles, procedures, and risk controls to engineering activities.
practical_example: Review a proposed electrical task and identify hazards and safeguards.

name: Electrical Fault Diagnosis and Maintenance
sdg_rationale: Fault finding and maintenance support reliability of electrical infrastructure.
description: Investigate electrical faults systematically and consider suitable maintenance or corrective actions.
practical_example: Use symptoms and measurements to outline a fault-finding process.

name: Patient Care and Monitoring
sdg_rationale: Develops patient-centred support and monitoring skills for health and lifelong learning.
description: Observe patient needs and changes in condition, deliver appropriate care within professional responsibilities, and record relevant observations.
practical_example: Describe how routine observations can be documented and escalated appropriately.

name: Nursing Assessment and Care Planning
sdg_rationale: Builds nursing assessment and care planning knowledge for healthcare quality and education.
description: Gather patient information, identify care needs, and contribute to an appropriate care plan within nursing practice.
practical_example: Organise assessment findings into care priorities and proposed follow-up.

name: Medication Safety and Administration
sdg_rationale: Improves learning about safe medicine administration and prevention of harm.
description: Follow authorised medication procedures and safety checks to reduce preventable administration errors.
practical_example: Identify the verification checks required before medication administration in a supervised case exercise.

name: Infection Prevention and Control
sdg_rationale: Supports infection prevention knowledge and safe healthcare practice.
description: Apply infection-prevention procedures to reduce the spread of infection in care environments.
practical_example: Choose appropriate hand-hygiene and precaution steps for a simulated care scenario.

name: Patient Communication and Empathy
sdg_rationale: Builds respectful communication and empathy as professional healthcare skills.
description: Listen respectfully and communicate clearly and empathetically with patients, families, and care teams.
practical_example: Explain a care instruction in accessible language and check understanding.
